function BenillaKeyBindings_CharacterToggle(box)
            PlaySound("igMainMenuOptionCheckBoxOn")
            if box:GetChecked() then
                LoadBindings(2)
                SaveBindings(2)
                BenillaKeyBindings_SetSelected(nil)
                BenillaKeyBindings_Output("")
                BenillaKeyBindingsPage_Refresh()
            else
                box:SetChecked(1)
                StaticPopup_Show("BENILLA_CONFIRM_DELETING_CHARACTER_SPECIFIC_BINDINGS")
            end
        end

        -- Our key: Blizzard_BindingUI.lua:10 defines the stock one for its own window.
        StaticPopupDialogs["BENILLA_CONFIRM_DELETING_CHARACTER_SPECIFIC_BINDINGS"] = {
            text = BenillaKeyBindings_String("CONFIRM_DELETING_CHARACTER_SPECIFIC_BINDINGS",
                "Really switch to general key bindings?  All key bindings specific to this character will be permanantly deleted."),
            button1 = BenillaKeyBindings_String("OKAY", "Okay"),
            button2 = BenillaKeyBindings_String("CANCEL", "Cancel"),
            OnAccept = function()
                LoadBindings(1)
                SaveBindings(1)
                BenillaKeyBindings_SetSelected(nil)
                BenillaKeyBindings_Output("")
                BenillaKeyBindingsPage_Refresh()
            end,
        }

custom_page_constructor.contract: Empty binding label or section/binding rows; no character selector or popup construction.

limits: Exact shipped embedded Lua; interpreter host calls are fixtures.
